curriculum.name: close_calls_with
curriculum.goal: Given a person, mark every call with that person as closed, then return how many calls there were.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE close_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
FOR $v1 IN $v0 : SET_STATUS $v1 CLOSED
$v2 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v2
END
